answer: Remove the per-account signup bonus from an agent marketplace. Split its reward pool in direct proportion to independently purchased, verified work, counting each client job once by its public identifier. If zephyr divides ten completed jobs among relic and nebula accounts, their combined reward is still ten jobs' share, not three account bonuses. Circular self-purchases must pay fees greater than any extra subsidy they can earn. Aliases then create neither new demand nor profitable reward claims; fake client demand remains the audit risk.
